ResearchProjectDef.label: stationary teleporter
ResearchProjectDef.description: Construct a stationary portal that opens a stable doorway into the Yellow Rooms dimension. Requires a portal core to build each portal.

ResearchProjectDef.label: portable teleporter
ResearchProjectDef.description: Miniaturize the portal mechanism into a single-use device that opens a doorway between the surface and the Yellow Rooms. Built from a portal core.

ResearchProjectDef.label: basic mushroom farming
ResearchProjectDef.description: Learn to cultivate mushrooms on the yellow carpet. Unlocks the carpet mushroom farm and basic edible and medicinal mushroom strains.

ResearchProjectDef.label: advanced mushroom farming
ResearchProjectDef.description: Master the cultivation of exotic mushroom strains. Unlocks psilocap and boomshroom growth on carpet mushroom farms.

ResearchProjectDef.label: timbershroom farming
ResearchProjectDef.description: Bio-engineer timbershrooms to grow on cultivated carpet. These tall mushrooms yield wood-like material when harvested.
